what: Lab 5, Grade 10 (L5-G10a): Daria's three Postman collections run green against the CPR compose with the 0.6.0 code, newman on the Compose network.

compose: a scratch override mapping player-service, server-moderation-session-service and message-broker to local 0.6.0 builds
stack.env: .env.example with random secrets and a new API key; BROKER_GRPC_URL empty (the compose default); PLAYER_REPLICAS=2, SESSION_REPLICAS=2, the teammates' services 1 replica each; SESSION_SHIFT_CLOSE_MODE=two-phase
stack.publishedImages: every other service from DockerHub as pinned in docker-compose.yml (0.5.0); drateeva/postgres-ha:16.16-patroni4.1.5

notes: executions counts repeats (Pull Applicants Until The Shift Limit runs until the shift limit). Skipped requests are skipped by the collections' own logic: the REST event stand-ins need standInUrl (off in the compose: events come from the Message Broker), and the live SSE stream is sent by hand (watchLive).

With BROKER_GRPC_URL=message-broker:9091 (the value in .env.example), the Gateway routes session's GET /rulesets/active (http mode, Gateway 8090) through MessageBroker.Call; server-rules-service's gRPC reply carries no Content-Type, the Gateway forwards none, and session answers next-applicant 503 DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE (11 assertions in the queue folder). Not part of Lab 5 or of the 0.6.0 changes (the broker passes ServiceReply headers through unchanged since 0.5.0); to be reported to the owners of the rules gRPC adapter and the Gateway's broker route (Diana).
